verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 151 West 54th Street, between Sixth and Seventh Avenues, with MoMA a block south, Carnegie Hall three blocks north and Central Park just beyond.
verified_facts.excerpt: 151 West 54th Street, between Sixth and Seventh Avenues. MoMA sits a block south, Carnegie Hall three north, and Central Park just beyond.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary MoMA admission is available to hotel guests.

verified_facts.text: Every suite is laid out like a London flat, with living space apart from the bedroom and a dedicated workspace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every suite follows the logic of a London flat. Living space sits apart from where you sleep, and a dedicated workspace means the two never compete for the same corner.

verified_facts.text: The Park View suites and the Premium Park View Apartment look out across Central Park.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are designed with herringbone wood floors, hand-tufted rugs and Carrara marble bathrooms.

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms have a whirlpool tub and marble vanities.

verified_facts.text: In-room comforts include an espresso machine, bathrobes and slippers.

verified_facts.text: The signature accommodations include the light-filled Atrium Suite, the Sky Suites and the Penthouse.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the light-filled Atrium Suite to the elevated Sky Suites and Penthouse, The London NYC’s signature accommodations offer an exceptional sense of space and privacy.

verified_facts.text: The hotel spans 54 floors in Midtown Manhattan.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spanning 54 floors, The London NYC offers expansive accommodations that bring a sense of residential ease to Midtown Manhattan.

verified_facts.text: A weekly Friday guided tour explores the hotel's art collection, with works by Matisse and Warhol alongside a Venice Biennale sculpture and a Turner Prize winner.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a weekly Friday guided tour of its art collection.

verified_facts.text: Dabble, the hotel's American restaurant near Carnegie Hall, suits pre-theatre dining or a nightcap.

verified_facts.text: The fitness center features Technogym equipment, including the Technogym Kinesis Personal Heritage.
